g.text: py-app-sticker-pr-mandelapark | type sticker | trim 700 x 700 mm, bleed 3 mm | status rebuilt
Bron: tien printbestanden (source/print). Referentie = getrouwe vectorweergave; template = officiele tokenkleuren, 3 mm bleed, variabelen als live tekst. Labels staan in aparte groepen.
Bron: PR_WTC_Sticker.pdf p1 (RGB (ICC); bleed box in bron nee). Template: trim 700 x 700 mm, bleed 3 mm, totaal 706 x 706 mm.
Variabelen: background-colour = #1A3580; label-pr = P+R; price = €6; price-suffix = ,-; label = per dag; location-line-1 = Parking; location-line-2 = Mandelapark

Snijcontour: groep cut-contour, spot ThruCut, 1 pt, 0.2 mm binnen de trim. Proposal: the source has no cut contour. Corner radius 4.2 mm is borrowed from the diefstal footer bar (4.23 mm); to be confirmed by the owner.

700 x 700 mm, no bleed in the source (page = trim, RGB ICC). The navy field is 700 x 516.1 mm and runs to the top and the sides (template: 3 mm into the bleed), the lower 183.9 mm is white paper (no ink, no white fill in the template). The reference keeps a navy rectangle (118.7 to 596.2 x 176.6 to 402.1 mm, #233A89) between the two bars: navy on

navy, invisible, left out of the template. P+R symbol: py-comp-symbol-pr scaled 4.968x at 143.0 / 132.7 mm, the label P+R is live Ubuntu Bold 225.2 mm white (variable label-pr, source text is live). Price bubble: py-comp-price-bubble-speech MATCHES: the 17 control points of the source path equal the library bubble at scale 0.6797 and rotation -0.67
degrees (residual 0.44 mm rms), so it is placed (strip_text) with that scale and rotation.
